_format: SVCv4 bundled classification envelope (illustrative). Statements and methods are declared ONCE in the `method` and `assessment` dictionaries (keyed by id) and referenced everywhere else by JSON-pointer (e.g. "#/assessment/pvs-pkp2:NUL_PRD"). This deduplicates the recursive VA-Spec 1.1.0 Statement tree into a flat, addressable graph.
_variant: PVS-PKP2 — PKP2 c.1481C>A (p.Ser494Ter, alt transcript NM_004572.4). Source tab: 'PKP2'.
_why_this_variant: This is the practice set's transcript-relevance gating exemplar. A nonsense change would normally read 100% protein loss via the protein-impact spectrum (+6.0). Here the nonsense-bearing exon is ABSENT from MANE Select, so the exon-relevance multiplier (NUL_PRD_EXON_REL, mane_status not_met) scales those points to 0, and an otherwise-PVS null collapses to a VUS. Scoring is illustrative; authority lives in CSpec.
_outcome_suffixes: Outcome suffix convention: `_+N` / `_-N` = a produced score; `_NA` = Not Applicable (the subcode's gating or required values aren't met — the would-be inputs are still shown so a downstream observer can verify the determination); `_ND` = No Data (scoring can't happen because the required data is absent). This variant's predictive lane is `_NA` (exon not in MANE); its population lane scored a real neutral `_+0`.

svcv4:PFD.name: SVCv4 Predictive & Functional Data roll-up
svcv4:PFD._note: The registry currently exposes this same node under CODE `PRD` (its label/methodType already read 'Predictive & Functional Data'). Recommend aligning the code to `PFD` to match the Summary Table categories (HOD + PFD).

svcv4:NUL_PRD_INIT_PROT_IMP.name: SVCv4 protein-impact spectrum (null) — nonsense = 100% loss when relevant

svcv4:NUL_PRD_EXON_REL.name: SVCv4 exon relevance (null) — MANE/transcript relevance multiplier
svcv4:NUL_PRD_EXON_REL._role: GATE/ADJUSTER — the exon-relevance multiplier (0..1). Its mane_status data item carries the met/not_met transcript-relevance decision; a not-in-MANE exon multiplies the initial protein-impact points by 0, which is how this variant's LoF points are withheld.

pvs-pkp2:NUL_PRD_INIT_PROT_IMP.description: Protein-impact spectrum for the nonsense p.Ser494Ter. NOT APPLICABLE (_NA): a PTC in a clinically relevant transcript would read 100% protein loss -> +6.0, but the exon-relevance gate (#/assessment/pvs-pkp2:NUL_PRD_EXON_REL) is not met (nonsense-bearing exon absent from MANE Select). The would-be inputs are shown below so a downstream observer can verify the _NA determination.

hasEvidenceItems.description: Protein-impact inputs for the nonsense change.

value.consequence: nonsense p.Ser494Ter (100% loss if in the relevant transcript)

pvs-pkp2:NUL_PRD_EXON_REL.description: Exon / transcript-relevance multiplier for the null lane. The mane_status data item is the transcript-relevance gate: the nonsense-bearing exon is ABSENT from MANE Select -> not relevant -> multiplier 0, which zeroes the protein-impact initial points. This is what demotes an otherwise-PVS null to a VUS.

value.mane_status: not_met — nonsense-bearing exon ABSENT from MANE Select

pvs-pkp2:NUL_PRD.description: Predicted loss-of-function (structural nonsense) assessment. NOT APPLICABLE (_NA): its only initial spectrum (protein-impact) is _NA because the exon-relevance gate is not met, so no predictive score is produced.

pvs-pkp2:NUL.description: Selected predictive lane for this variant: transcript-context-limited LoF evidence. NOT APPLICABLE (_NA): the predictive lane is _NA (exon not relevant) and no functional or informative-variant evidence was supplied.

pvs-pkp2:PFD.description: Predictive & Functional Data roll-up (the selected PRD family). NOT APPLICABLE (_NA): its only applicable family (NUL) is _NA. Always shown as the parent even so — the roll-up node is structural, not conditional.

pvs-pkp2:POP_FRQ.description: Population allele frequency (POP_FRQ) assessed as the observed filtering allele frequency (FAF) against the disease allele-frequency threshold (DAFT). FAF/DAFT fold = 0.061 lands in the NONE band — FAF is well below DAFT, so there is no benign-frequency evidence and no rarity adjustment. Neutral (POP_FRQ_+0).

hasEvidenceItems.description: Filtering allele frequency (FAF) — the observed population frequency input.

value.source: gnomAD v4.1 joint — popmax filtering allele frequency (95% CI upper bound)

hasEvidenceItems.description: Disease allele-frequency threshold (DAFT) — the max credible population AF this disease/gene could tolerate.
Computed FAF/DAFT fold and the band it selects (fold value + band choice combined).

value.fold_definition: FAF / DAFT — observed filtering AF relative to the disease allele-frequency threshold
value._note: Illustrative band ranges/points — authoritative thresholds live in CSpec. FAF below DAFT (fold < 1.0) selects NONE: too rare to be benign-frequency evidence, so 0 points.

pvs-pkp2:POP.description: Population observation roll-up (POP_FRQ + POP_HMZ). Only POP_FRQ applies here.

pvs-pkp2:HOD.description: Human Observational Data roll-up (POP + CLN + LOC). The single proband has only suspected (not clinically diagnosed) ARVC, so is not counted in CLN_AFF or LOC_PHE — no clinical or locus points. HOD = POP = 0.

variation._note: Placeholder VRS Variation. Source: ClinGen Allele ID CA384368604.

pvs-pkp2.description: Final SVCv4 classification. HOD (human observational data) + the selected PRD (NUL) lane both roll up to 0. A genuine VUS driven by transcript context: the NMD/LoF-relevance gate was not met, so the strong predicted-LoF points that a constitutive-exon nonsense would earn were never awarded.
